**Review (M3, safety tier): the code is clean. It conflicts with main, mechanically; per "Refresh only at merge time" it keeps `conflicts` and is refreshed in the merge batch.**

**What looks good:**
- `turn_cells.rs` replaces the 4x5 pose grid with a proven enclosure: the hull of the two end columns grown by the stated sag, then clipped against the tip chord. It is a strict superset of the old reading, so it can only add convictions.
- Degenerate input lands on the safe side: non-finite letters take the widest sag, `cell_count` is guarded and clamped, NaN is handled in `span`, and a disc inside a disc returns `None`.
- No unwrap or panic. Provenance is present, and `sweep.rs` (299 lines) and `turn_cells.rs` (240 lines) are under 400.
- The pin is real: with main's `sweep.rs` swapped back in, `a_holder_crossing_a_stock_post_between_two_sampled_poses_is_convicted` fails at `midturn_swept_band.rs:70`, and its twin stays clean.
- **Mutation note:** the integration pin guards that the sweep reads the turn at all. The cell count, sag and hull shape rest on the brute-force lib probe (`no_band_position_of_a_random_turn_lies_outside_the_cells`, which fails when the cells are forced to 1 with no sag). That is acceptable.

**Local results** (merged with main 90c71192, conflict resolved locally):
- `camcraft-sim`, all targets: 519 passed, 4 ignored.
- motion `solid_law` 6 and `vertical_arc_entry` 3.
- app `verify` 5, `rotary_verify` 9, `tool_body_bands` 13, `posed_contact` 21; the rest of the 48 gate-mapped app suites rest on the author's reported gate.
- Clippy on sim is clean.

**At merge-time refresh:** `crates/sim/src/verify/mod.rs` ~line 192 needs keep-both, `mod thread_bore;` (main) then `mod turn_cells;`. Everything else auto-merges. #1324 is stacked on this PR.

**Notes:** the overhang backstop still reads the 4x5 grid (#1316). Release-lane false convictions and verify time are not measured; a cap of 64 cells per band bounds the cost.

Refreshed for the merge batch: merged `upstream/main` into this branch (head 727564f3, one merge commit, no force push).

**The clash.** Main's 3cee560c / de1d8641 (#1303) changed the sampled pose loop in `verify/sweep.rs::swing_hit`, the loop this PR replaced with turn cells:
- a per-pose span floor (`tilt_span::span_floor`)
- the rim's exact dip, R·sin θ, instead of the whole radius R

`verify/mod.rs` was a keep-both (`mod thread_bore;` + `mod turn_cells;`).

**The span-floor port.**
- `sweep::band_floors` computes #1303's span floor at the five sampled turn fractions. In `push_cells`, any cell that holds one of those fractions reads no higher than that floor. The cells tile [0, 1], so every sampled pose falls in a cell whose hull holds its column. That cell now reads no higher than main's `min(exact dip, span floor)`.
- The backstop columns read main's `tilt_band::lean` column with its exact dip, lowered by the same span floor.

**Decision: the exact dip per cell.** When the cells kept the whole radius, main's `tilt_tolerance::a_tilt_just_above_the_tolerance_reads_like_upright_and_a_real_dip_convicts` failed: a holder 5 mm clear, tilted 1.01e-9 rad, got a `SweepHit`. That is the cliff at the upright tolerance that #1303 removed. Both laws cannot hold, so the main session decided that #1303's law wins for that class; the maintainer can overrule.
- Each cell's bottom is now `min(lo0, lo1) - R·min(1, max(sin θ0, sin θ1) + kappa) - sag`.
- This is sound: inside a cell the axis strays from its chord by at most kappa, so the rim's sine stays under the larger end's sine plus kappa.
- Dropped: keeping the whole radius and changing main's test.
- One number in this PR's tests follows from it: `the_kerf_excuses_only_where_the_tip_stands` now expects the bottom at `5 - 4.8` minus a dip of at most 6·sin 1°, instead of a whole 6 mm lower.

The decision is recorded in `docs/decisions/1313-midturn-swept-band.md`.

**Pins and mutation checks.**
- New pin `turn_cells::tests::a_cell_holding_a_sampled_pose_reads_its_span_floor`: A 100 -> 260, and only the span floor reaches a column under the far rim of the A 100 pose. With the floor removed from `push_cells`, this pin fails.
- `midturn_swept_band::a_holder_crossing_a_stock_post_between_two_sampled_poses_is_convicted`: with the cells replaced by the five sampled poses, this test fails.
- Main's #1303 tests (`tilt_span`, `tilt_band`, `tilt_tolerance`) pass unchanged.

**Gate (final head).**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: every test passes.
- `camcraft-app`: golden_cl 6/6, solid_law 26/26, solid_law_goldens 4/4, coarse_laws 6/6.
- `clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -D warnings`: clean.
- `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets` fails only on main's own `tests/coarse_rims.rs` break (#1345, fix in PR #1348); this PR doesn't touch that file.

Ready for a safety delta review.

**Delta review (M3, safety tier) of the merge port at 727564f3: the law is sound. Two of its claimed readings have no pin, so I'm requesting pins before merge** (same standard as #1081 and #1061).

Trial-merged with current main (dfc50d4b): clean.

**What looks good**
- **The cell bottom is a proven lower bound.** Main's #1303 exact dip wins. The bottom, `min(lo0,lo1) - R·min(1, max(sinθ0, sinθ1) + kappa) - sag`, lies below every band position in the cell:
  - the axis is a product of unit rotations, so it strays from its chord by at most w²/8 = kappa;
  - that bounds the dip (the norm is convex) and the stations (concave in az) at any cell size, the 64-cell cap and non-finite letters included;
  - a 20,000-turn numeric scan straddling 90° found no violation.
- **The span floors** at sampled fractions compose by `min`.
- **The backstop** now reads exactly main's #1303 column (lean, exact dip, span floor), so it loses nothing relative to main.
- **The new bound in `the_kerf_excuses_only_where_the_tip_stands` is physically tight,** not loosened: measured -0.306 against a bound of -0.405, with the old 0.1 margin kept.

**Local results** (merged with main)
- camcraft-sim: 527 passed, including `tilt_tolerance` 5, `midturn_swept_band` 2 and the `turn_cells` units 5.
- app: `verify` 21, `rotary_verify` 9, `tool_body_bands` 13, `posed_contact` 5.
- Clippy is clean.

**Mutations**
- Killed: dropping the span-floor fold, point poses in place of cells, and kappa = 0 everywhere.
- **Survived:** dropping only the `+ kappa` from the dip (`turn_cells.rs:127`). Without it the cell under-reads by up to about 5.5 µm, per the scan.
- **Survived:** deleting the backstop's span-floor line (`sweep.rs` ~250-258), and reverting the backstop to the whole radius.

**Requested before merge**
1. Pin the `+ kappa` in the cell dip: a cell straddling a 90° tilt (e.g. B 60 → 121, large R, short reach) whose bottom is ≤ the true minimum over a dense pose scan, so that removing `+ kappa` fails.
2. Pin the backstop's exact-dip and span-floor reading with a hidden-stock probe where the span floor alone convicts (e.g. A 100 → 260). #1324 builds on this backstop.

**Note:** in the decision file, add that the kappa bound needs no cap assumption.
Back to draft while the two pins the safety review asked for (the cell dip's `+ kappa`, the backstop's exact dip and span floor) land on this branch. Flagged ready again once pushed and gated.

Pins for the safety review's two requests are pushed (head bf8d9e8f, one test-only commit, no merge of main). The branch still merges cleanly.

**Pin 1: `verify::turn_cells::tests::a_cell_straddling_a_flat_pose_reads_the_flat_rim`** (`crates/sim/src/verify/turn_cells_tests.rs`)
- Guards the `+ kappa` in a cell's rim dip (`turn_cells.rs:127`).
- Setup: B 60 -> 120 with a band 100 wide (radius) and 0.5 long at the tip. The cell holding 90° ends at 86.7° and 93.3°, so both of its end poses dip the rim by 99.83. The flat pose between them dips the whole 100. The sag (reach x kappa, about 0.5 µm) can't cover that gap.
- Asserts:
  - a stock post over the tip, topped at -100, is convicted (the flat band dips 1.25 µm into it);
  - every cell's bottom is at or under the band's true bottom across a 400-step pose scan of its own interval.

**Pin 2: `verify::sweep::tests::the_backstop_reads_the_exact_dip_lowered_by_the_span_floor`** (new sibling `crates/sim/src/verify/sweep_tests.rs`)
- Guards the backstop reading #1303's column: exact dip, lowered by the span floor.
- Setup: A 100 -> 260. Band 20 up, radius 10, 30 long (L = 50); cutter radius 2. The probe drives `swing_hit` with no sample columns, so only the backstop speaks. A hidden post at (5, 0) sits only under the A 180 column; every other pose's column leans 22 mm or more off along Y.
- Expected readings over the post:
  - exact dip: -L, since R·sin 180 = 0;
  - span floor toward A 140 / 220: -L - R·sin 40 = **-56.43**;
  - whole radius: -60.
- Asserts the exact verdicts and the reading:
  - post topped at -53 -> `Some(false)` (convicted);
  - post topped at -58 -> `None` (clean);
  - `backstop_columns` reads -56.43 over the post (within 1e-9).

**Mutation checks** (each applied alone, then restored)

| Mutation | Pin | Result | Direction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drop `+ kappa` from the cell dip | pin 1 | **red** | Convicts less: the post's column reads -99.92, 0.08 mm clear of a post the band dips into. The dense scan also fails: cell 4/9 reads -99.861 over a band reaching -100.001. |
| Delete the backstop's span-floor line | pin 2 | **red** | Convicts less: the -53 post reads `None`, expected `Some(false)`; the reading is -50. |
| Backstop column back to the whole radius R | pin 2 | **red** | Convicts more: the -58 post reads `Some(false)`, expected `None`; the reading is -60. |

**Gate (head bf8d9e8f)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: 529 passed, 0 failed (527 + the two pins).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Delta re-review (M3, safety tier) at bf8d9e8f: ready for the maintainer to merge. Both requested pins are added, and both catch their mutation.**

**The delta is test-only:** two new test functions, plus the `#[cfg(test)]` module line in `sweep.rs`.

**Pin 1:** `turn_cells::tests::a_cell_straddling_a_flat_pose_reads_the_flat_rim` (B 60→120, R 100).
- It convicts a -100 post, and a 400-step scan checks that every cell bottom is at or below the true band bottom.
- With `+ kappa` removed from `turn_cells.rs:127`, it fails. I re-ran this locally.

**Pin 2:** `sweep::tests::the_backstop_reads_the_exact_dip_lowered_by_the_span_floor` (A 100→260, backstop only).
- With the span-floor lowering at `sweep.rs:253` deleted, it fails. I re-ran this locally.
- The author reports that reverting the backstop to the whole radius also fails it.

**Local results:** camcraft-sim lib 120 passed, and clippy on sim is clean.

**Labels:** I set the earlier `needs-rework`, so I've removed it now.

**Note:** pin 2's hidden stock is a closure modelled on `hidden_in_annulus`, not real ledge geometry. That is enough to pin the reading.
